description: Exact public HTTPS GET recipes for the five approved AIedu Alignment research tasks. Origins/URLs are official docs for the demo stack (PostgreSQL, Docker security, Playwright, Next.js, Docker Compose production). Labeled for dogfood; no credentials.

recipes.notes: Official PostgreSQL DDL docs — schema design, constraints, and related migration guidance.
Official Docker Engine security docs for trust boundaries / container host hardening (stack also uses Compose, PostgreSQL, Redis).
Official Playwright best-practices for real browser verification flows.
Official Next.js App Router getting-started (AIedu frontend is Next.js 15 / React). FastAPI guidance remains local-code + https://fastapi.tiangolo.com/ when expanding recipes.
Official Docker Compose production how-to for deployment/CI environment assumptions.
